messages:
maya (Marketing): T-minus 24h — can we lock the announce flow? Need final changelog snippet, docs links, and a confirmed canary window. Also reserving the 10:30 AM PT webinar demo slot. Who can ✋ for slides review?
ben (Eng): Can do canary window. We have a quantization toggle still gating perf run. Plan: canary 11:00-13:00 PT, fallback to smaller model if perf regresses. Link to PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/release/compare/feat/release-wire
carla (Docs): I'll publish the changelog and quickstart this afternoon. Adding a short 'what's changed' at top + migration notes. Draft link will be live at 17:00 PT: https://docs.redwood.com/release/4951234567-draft
diego (PM): Marketing, what's the one-line lead message for the email/webinar banner? Need to include the benchmark hook and a CTA for trial credits.
maya (Marketing): One-liner draft: "Faster inference, lower cost — try the new adaptive batching & quantization profiles". Will iterate if eng wants to call out specific numbers. Also adding UTM tags for webinar->trial funnel: ?utm_source=announce&utm_campaign=release_may24
eve (Release): Runbook attached: /runbooks/release-4951234567.md — includes rollback steps, canary cutover, and DB feature flags. Will trigger deploy-bot 10m before canary. @deploy-bot will post status.
deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy at 10:50 PT. Canary window 11:00-13:00 PT. Will post success/failure in #release-war-room.
ben (Eng): For messaging accuracy: if we call out 'lower cost' let's reference the Optimize-recommended median savings: ~28% for long-sequence workloads (internal bench). Don't publish raw numbers without QA signoff.
carla (Docs): I'll include a small benchmark note with a link to the benchmark notebook (internal) and mark it as "internal metrics" until RM confirms.
maya (Marketing): For inbound routing: can someone confirm SFDC leadflow? We want webinar signups to create MQL with tag "release_may24" and route to AE squad B.
diego (PM): Confirmed — Hubspot -> SFDC sync already maps webinar sources. @olivia can you ensure registration form includes hidden field 'release_may24' and the webhook to create MQL?
olivia (Webinar Ops): Yes, will add hidden field and run a quick test at 15:30 PT. Slide review at 16:00 PT — can attendees from Eng + Docs join?
ben (Eng): I'll be there for the demo run. Will bring sample prompt + perf graph.
carla (Docs): I'll join to sanity-check the quickstart steps on screen.
eve (Release): Final ask: please post the changelog bullet here once published so we can pin it in the announcement thread and include the exact URL in the email.
maya (Marketing): Will post the final changelog URL and the PR for announcement copy by 17:15 PT. Thanks everyone — short check-in at 16:00 for slides and 17:15 for final signoff. :thumbsup:
olivia (Webinar Ops): Got it — running regression test for the registration webhook at 15:30, ping back if it fails.
ben (Eng): Quick note — if the canary shows memory spike, we'll flip `use_kv_cache=false` and rerun. Putting the command here for ops: `./ctl rollback --flag use_kv_cache=false --release 4951234567`
maya (Marketing): Perfect. If anything blocks the email send, DM me. Otherwise we proceed with the 18:00 PT announcement cadence and webinar at 10:30 AM PT tomorrow. :rocket:
